assumptions: Continues the original loaded launch/deployment/deorbit state below its descending 90 km witness. Uses existing production aerodynamic forces and flap/attitude actuators, bank-limited descent guidance and an estimated transition from 70 degree entry to 90 degree broadside descent. Controls, transition thresholds, rate and the 3 km diagnostic endpoint are engineering estimates, not measured Flight 14 commands. No forces, state, fuel or thermal values are imposed. No geographic landing corridor, powered landing, header-tank routing, real water contact or mission acceptance is established by this diagnostic.
